entities.summary: Otto Ehrenfried Ehlers was a German explorer and travel writer who is known in English-speaking countries for his account of a long trip through inland Southeast Asia, documented in his 1894 book Im Sattel durch Indochina, and republished in 2002 by White Lotus Press of Thailand in English as a three-part series entitled On Horseback Through Indochina.
